sources.title: Wikidata Q11274 (the Lexington Avenue Art Deco tower)

heightM.note: height (P2048), architectural: the spire's tip above the street

roofM.note: height (P2048) to the roof: where the tiers end and the generic spire begins

footprint.note: the lower block's plan (the S07a kit's stylised footprint)

tier1M.note: the base block's height; tiers proportioned by eye from the S07a kit

tier4M.note: the top tier, inset 5 m, up to the Wikidata roof height (282 m less the tiers below)

spireBaseM.note: the generic spire's base width (LEGAL-1: never a copy of the real crown)

readabilityScale.note: No thin members: windows are bands of glass, the spire a plain taper.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.12 and widths x1.2 against the numbers above (1.2 keeps the footprint inside the frame's exclusion), so the tower stands out from the real-scale district around it without dwarfing it.
